title: Polynomial characterization of shares
statement: Let $F$ be a field, $d$ a natural number, $x\in F$, and $f$ a function from the nonzero elements of $F$ to $F$. The function $f$ is a sharing of $x$ of degree at most $d$ if there is a polynomial $p\in F[X]$ of degree less than $d+1$ such that $p(0)=x$ and, at every nonzero field element $i$, $f(i)=p(i)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps nonzero field elements to field elements
